title: DIFFNAS: Predictor-Free Neural Architecture Search via Diffusion Model and Zero-Cost Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has advanced the automated design of deep networks, but remains computationally expensive due to reliance on model training or performance predictors. We introduce DIFFNAS, a predictor-free NAS framework that leverages a discrete graph diffusion model guided by zero-cost performance proxies. Unlike prior diffusion-based NAS methods that require learned performance predictors, DIFFNAS conditions the generative process on training-free metrics such as MeCo and SWAP, enabling efficient architecture search with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show that DIFFNAS finds the optimal architectures for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (94.37% and 73.51%) without a pretrained predictor, while reducing search cost by up to 17.5x compared to DiffusionNAG. On the MobileNetV3 search space, its accuracy is lower than that of DiffusionNAG. These results highlight the promise of diffusion models combined

translated_title: DIFFNAS：基于扩散模型与零成本评估的无预测器神经架构搜索
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）推动了深度网络的自动化设计，但由于依赖模型训练或性能预测器，其计算成本依然高昂。我们提出了DIFFNAS，这是一个无预测器的NAS框架，它利用由零成本性能代理引导的离散图扩散模型。与以往需要学习性能预测器的基于扩散的NAS方法不同，DIFFNAS将生成过程条件化于无需训练的指标（如MeCo和SWAP），从而能够以极小的计算开销实现高效的架构搜索。在NAS-Bench-201上的实验表明，DIFFNAS在无需预训练预测器的情况下，为CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100找到了最优架构（准确率分别为94.37%和73.51%），同时与DiffusionNAG相比将搜索成本降低了高达17.5倍。在MobileNetV3搜索空间上，其准确率低于DiffusionNAG。这些结果凸显了扩散模型与零成本评估相结合的潜力。
tldr: DIFFNAS提出了一种无需性能预测器的神经架构搜索框架，利用零成本指标（MeCo、SWAP）引导离散图扩散模型生成架构，在NAS-Bench-201上找到CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100的最优架构，并将搜索成本相比DiffusionNAG降低高达17.5倍。
en_tdlr: DIFFNAS is a predictor-free NAS framework that uses a discrete graph diffusion model conditioned on zero-cost metrics (MeCo, SWAP), achieving optimal architectures on NAS-Bench-201 for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 while reducing search cost by up to 17.5x compared to DiffusionNAG.
